scenes.text: Imagine standing in a fifty-square-mile strip of land where you could theoretically commit the perfect crime and walk away completely free.
This is not a movie plot; it is a real geographical loophole in Yellowstone National Park known as the Zone of Death.
Because exactly zero people live in this overlap zone, it is physically impossible to form a jury, meaning a trial cannot legally happen.
Would you ever dare to camp in this lawless strip? Comment your thoughts below.
